about: What the word marks and checks read. notes says where each came from. The second model's own constants are not here: they were set without the follower (scripts/recitation-bench/judge/judge_constants.json), apart from secondJudge.altMargin. For now this file is built into the app's JavaScript: before a public release it must be delivered with the model and its licence file.

notes.marks: The rules in services/recitation/wordMarks.ts, each explained beside where it is read. Set on bench recitations through the follower's verdicts and gop scores: planted mistakes, then voices behind correct recitation.
notes.engine: commitDwell: heard sounds after a word before the engine judges it. Measured on five reciters with planted mistakes. cutAtJump: a forward jump of more than this many places in the text starts a new stretch of alignment, so the work a chunk stays bounded. Compared at 300, 3000 and 10000 on the longest-jump clips under voices: at 10000 no verdict changed there.
notes.junction: Set on the dev split of the junction job (scripts/recitation-bench/natural/junction/README.md), frozen in .out/natural/junction/frozen_v2.json. llrMissing: per token of the last word, h1 - h0 under this says it was left out. fitNext and fitLate: how well h0 must fit on the early and late paths, in nats. lookBackFrames, anchorTokens, waitFrames, lookBackWords: where the hypotheses look.
notes.gapReport: Mechanics of the split behind the added-word mark, on the follower's sounds (scripts/recitation-bench/added/README.md).
notes.addedWord: Set on dev reciters and dev events, frozen in .out/added/frozen.sha256 (scripts/recitation-bench/added/README.md). fit and fitLast reuse the engine's okDistance and unsureDistance. notTextPhrases are the isti'adha, basmala, takbir, closing formula and amin in the follower's phonemes, for matching only: they are never shown.
notes.secondJudge: scripts/recitation-bench/judge/engine_constants.npl.json, frozen on dev. wakeStep1 and wakeStep2: the verdicts that wake it at each step. wakeOkGop and wakeOkNoGop: Step 2 also wakes on an ok word with gop at or below this, or with no gop and some distance. altMargin: an alternative must beat the expected word by this many nats; read from a table with no follower output, but fixed after the follower's end-to-end sweep on dev had been seen, so it is kept here. holdSeconds: the judge answers from the slice one chunk after the verdict. The rest place the slice: tracker lag against the second model's first letter, cursor lag when the tracker has no frames, a slice may start this long after the end of the ayah before, this long before the first word when there is no ayah before, and a shorter slice means the places were wrong, so use the last fallbackSeconds.
notes.cancel: scripts/second-look/cancel_constants.npl.json, chosen on marks the follower made: on QuranMB's planted errors, with professional false marks and W1 marks, none held out (scripts/second-look/RULE.md). QuranMB's licence for this use is not yet confirmed (IqraEval has not answered), so keepFirstPerLetter and keepGap need the owner's decision before any release. keepFirstPerLetter: a mark stays if the expected word scores at or below this per letter on the judge's slice. keepGap: or if a spelling with one inner letter changed beats the written word by at least this many nats on the padded look. marginSeconds: the padded look takes the word and this much either side. silenceSeconds: digital silence added each side. minCutSeconds: a shorter cut is a failure, and the mark shows.
